about.title: About Mentegraf
about.description: Mentegraf is a visual knowledge mapping tool for authors. Plan your book by creating nodes for concepts, people, ideas, and chapters, then visualize the relationships between them.

addNode.title: Adding Nodes
addNode.desc: Click ⊕ in the left toolbar for a free node. Click the + button next to a selected node to add a connected node.

connect.title: Creating Connections
connect.desc: Select a node, hold Alt, a dashed line appears. While holding Alt, click the target node to create an edge.

editNode.title: Editing Nodes
editNode.desc: Click a node → side panel slides in. Edit name, type, description, notes, and tags. Name updates live on the graph.

edgeWeight.title: Edge Strength
edgeWeight.desc: Click an edge → side panel. Set strength 1-5, relation type (influences, contradicts, etc.) and add notes. Strength controls line width.

search.title: Search
search.desc: The search box in the top bar searches node labels. Matches are highlighted, single results auto-zoom.

filter.title: Type Filtering
filter.desc: Toggle node type buttons in the top bar to show/hide specific types. Hidden type edges are also hidden.

multiSelect.title: Multi-Select
multiSelect.desc: Ctrl+click (Mac: Cmd+click) to select multiple nodes. A bottom bar appears with bulk delete option.

undoRedo.title: Undo / Redo
undoRedo.desc: Ctrl+Z to undo, Ctrl+Shift+Z to redo. Up to 40 steps. Every node/edge add, delete, and move is tracked.

themes.title: Theme & Language
themes.desc: Theme (dark/light) and language (TR/EN) toggles at the bottom of the left toolbar. Preferences are remembered.

settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: ⚙ button to customize node types and connection types. Edit color, name (TR/EN), and icon. Each project carries its own settings.

save.title: Saving
save.desc: Ctrl+S to save. Auto-save every 30 seconds. Use File → Save As to create a .mentegraf file.

export.title: Exporting
export.desc: 5 formats: JSON (re-importable), HTML Publish (shareable web page), Obsidian (Markdown), SVG (print), CSV (spreadsheet).

zotero.title: Zotero Integration
zotero.desc: Import books and articles from your Zotero library with the Z button. Authors become person nodes automatically. Imported nodes show an "Open in Zotero" button.

reportDesc: Export descriptions, notes and connections for selected node types
reportPickCats: Select node types to include in report:
saveFirst: Save the project first: texts are stored in the project folder.
textMissing: The text file is missing. Create a new, empty text at the same path?
textChangedOutside:
This text was changed outside Mentegraf, and you also have unsaved edits here.

OK: load the outside version (Ctrl+Z brings your edits back).
Cancel: keep your version; saving will overwrite the outside change.
tbHeading: Heading level (click again for the next level)
tbFootnote: Footnote (Ctrl+Shift+F). In the note, press again to return to the text
tbPassage: Passage ID (Ctrl+Shift+P): tags the paragraph and copies its link
footnoteHint: Write the note; Ctrl+Shift+F takes you back to the text
passageNeedsText: Put the cursor inside a paragraph first
zoteroUnavailable: Zotero is not running: brackets added, type the key by hand
bbtMissing: Better BibTeX not found in Zotero: brackets added
cfgSaveFirst: Save the project first to choose a style and a template.
cfgStyleNote: Chosen files are copied into the project’s styles/ folder, so the project exports the same everywhere.
cfgNotCsl: This is not a citation style (.csl) file.
cfgDependent: This is a dependent style: it only points to another style. Choose its parent style instead.
cfgNotDocx: This is not a Word (.docx) file.
binderEmpty: The book plan is empty. Add a part or a chapter, or add the node selected in the graph.
includeOn: Included in the compiled book (click to leave out)
includeOff: Left out of the compiled book (click to include)
removeFromBook: Remove from the book plan (the node stays in the graph)
selectNodeFirst: Select a node in the graph first
alreadyInBook: This node is already in the book plan
cannotIndent: Cannot move one level deeper here
binderKeys: ↑ ↓ move · Tab / Shift+Tab level · Enter open · Delete remove from plan
compileEmpty: There are no included chapters to compile
tbFigure: Figure or table (Ctrl+Shift+G) — you can also paste or drop images
figInsertTip: Put the figure or table here
figRefTip: Refer to it in the text ("Figure N" in the export)
figNone: No figures or tables yet. Paste an image, drop a file onto the text, or add one below.
noTags: No tags yet. Add them in the node panel, separated by commas.
catEmpty: No categories yet. Arrange your topics as a tree, e.g. Cybernetics › Feedback.
catDeleteConfirm: The category "%s" is used by %n nodes. Delete it? (Its subcategories move up one level.)
classesKeys: Click: filter · Double-click: rename · Drag: move
figNoFile: This figure has no image yet.
figNoTable: This table has no CSV file yet.
searchNoNode: This text is not attached to a node.
searchLinkTip: Link this text's node to the selected node: %s
searchLinkedTip: Already linked to the selected node: %s
tbArgue: Claim, question or task (Ctrl+Shift+K / U / T)
argPopHint: Enter: save · Shift+Enter: new line · Esc: cancel
passageMissing: The passage is no longer in the text (deleted, or its ^id changed).
passageNoText: The text of this passage is not attached to a node.
queueEmpty: Nothing to do. In a text, Ctrl+Shift+U adds a question and Ctrl+Shift+T a task.
